NOTES
Basis: owner plan LT45.1 (25 Oct 2026), two-engine tender. Rev T2 = TW-1 S1+D1+K1+B1.
Body X400-4600 x Y+-1300; deck Z1096 (rail top +6); roof Z2360.
Rails HSS10x4x1/4 Y+-700; fish-belly bolsters to centre plate.
PF-DB boxes both ends, 286 drop. Trucks = coach truck C-303.
LEFT: AIE Kubota V3307 + radiator + H1P053 (1,028 tall); cooler >=14 kW X3455-4145.
RIGHT (rev TB-3 approved): genset reservation X1060-2768 (≤ 1,775)
R wall NEMA 3R elec. cabinet X2820-3780, outward doors; listed UL 1008
ATS w/ integral main. Main bkr QOM22225NRB encl., handle <= Z1639. Batt X2850-3200.
Fuel 150 L custom Al X3900-4500 behind steel firewall X3800.
MR 3x Haldex 19820 X3600-4440; IR 2340 compressor L fwd X460-840.
trucks 43.7/39.4 kN. LORD CB-1180-2 x4. XFMR assy 168.7 kg CG [2502,24,608]:
Acme T2535173S Z420-851 on isolators; L3x3 cradle, 2xM16 8.8 thru-bolts
/hanger at Z963 w/ crush tubes (no rail welds); shield 3 mm Z300 Y+-560.
Inrush box on cradle X2360-2665. Nothing under deck aft of X2900.
Unit top CLASHES X2500 xmbr 15 (K2-xf).
REV T2 SCHEDULE (owner approved 27 Oct 2026)
SKIN: 10 ga (3.4 mm) steel sides, ends, roof; bolted (round-head) or
plug-welded to HSS2x2x1/8 posts + roof bows at <=500 (riveted look).
No continuous seam welds on the sides (oil-canning). 50 mm lining kept.
DECK: 6 mm tread plate, sealed spill floor, on rails + 7 C6x8.2
cross-bearers (outboard to skin; between rails where no crossmember
or bolster). Equipment mounts land on rails / bearers.
COVER: coal-effect, 1.5 mm (16 ga) formed steel, removable, black
textured coal finish, gold edge trim. Height 200 ASSUMED.
BOLSTERS: fish-belly PL10 webs, PL12 flanges; full depth over Y+-300.
WHEELS: Ø600 plate-web, rim 50 / web 25 / hub Ø200 (section ASSUMED).
Tender mass rev TB-3.4/L4 ≈ 8,465.3 kg (Tender Bot TB-3.4, 28 Oct; xfmr assy 168.7 kg).
